contract.title: D1 dynamic link rate round-3 cold-start review (commit 026eb17)
contract.goal: Review exact commit 026eb17cd41a2645ab58ae1b8fd0e256f1f19cb1 on branch codex/20260819-d1-dynamic-rate. Re-check the round-2 REQUEST_CHANGES findings: (F1) retiring-uplink bypass of availability gates must be closed; (F2) GSL exact recovery/deadline race must not degrade to time_step polling and GE receipt counters must not leak; (F5) ISL zero-rate/no-deadline must not loop at horizon. Also confirm legacy RF/MCS equivalence, zero-rate/geometry-loss/GE-down queue and service semantics for shared uplink/downlink/ISL, snapshot residual-service accounting, legal masks, counters/receipt, deadline/retirement/GE-geometry races, and regression test adequacy. Return APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES with FACT/INFERENCE/UNVERIFIED, exact path/line evidence, concrete reproduction conditions, severity and open_items. Do not modify code.
acceptance: Explicit re-check of round-2 F1/F2/F5 with line evidence
Every major finding has exact evidence and reproduction condition
requiredEvidence: Exact commit-bound GitHub paths and line references
